6ab3b736e2e641b7fbeb6312.title: SOVEREIGN SA
6ab3b736e2e641b7fbeb6312.opening:
> D0 | Seocho-gu - Hunter Association

*测定台的指示灯由红转绿，工作人员把上一份记录扣在桌面上。招募区的几个人同时安静下来。*

💬Seo Rihwa | “下一位。先别向机器输送力量，把手放在标记的位置。”

*她把一张空白能力说明卡推到台边。招募区的黄线仍横在几家公会代表与测定台之间。*
suggestions: 我先询问测定过程会有哪些风险。
我把手放在感应板上，观察指示灯。
我想知道，各家公会为什么都在等这次测定。

6aaad8746c080a5d3ff0402a.title: APEX Heroes Academy
6aaad8746c080a5d3ff0402a.opening:
> D0 | Los Angeles - Apex Hero Academy

*入口屏幕轮播着 POWER. DISCIPLINE. RESPONSIBILITY. 山下传来交通声，训练区的防护门正在缓缓合拢。*

💬Leah Serrano | “新来的？报到台在这里。能力栏可以先留空，不必为了填表随便写一个。”

*隔着玻璃，一位教官把救援模拟区的地图摊在桌上。*

💬Mara Keene | “进训练区前，我需要知道你能控制什么。”
suggestions: 我想先了解救援训练，而不是战斗排名。
我向教官说明自己的能力和已经知道的限制。
我问 Leah，第一天最容易踩的坑是什么。

6ab70e13499de207c7ca13c4.title: Dating the Strongest Hero
6ab70e13499de207c7ca13c4.opening:
> D0 | Hero Authority - private waiting room

*门外的采访声隔着玻璃变得模糊。Kaia 的手机亮了一次，又一次；她把屏幕转向桌面，没有接听。*

💬Kaia Voss | “他们现在只知道我有男朋友，还不知道是谁。”

*她把一份尚未确认的声明草稿放在桌边，留着可以随时收回的距离。*

💬Kaia Voss | “我想先听你的。不是公关部的。”
suggestions: 我希望暂时保持匿名，但不想被过度保护。
我想看看那份声明，哪些内容可以由我们自己决定？
我先问 Kaia，她刚才为什么会脱口说出那句话。

6ac749a7ab586f53935a023d.title: Failed Knight of the Swordsmanship Family SA
6ac749a7ab586f53935a023d.opening:
> D0 | House Aster - old practice yard

*木牌上的旧考核记录还没被取下。长凳旁放着修过护手的练习剑，一封未拆的复测邀请压在剑鞘下面。*

💬Iven Harrow | “先别急着证明什么。那次失手，你记得剑是从哪一刻开始不听使唤的吗？”

*Maelis 站在廊檐的阴影里，没有替任何人回答。*
suggestions: 我想先检查那把练习剑，而不是接受复测。
我向 Iven 描述考核时真正发生的事。
我问 Maelis，这次邀请是她的意思还是家族的意思。

6ab2217bfa760164cd6c2f12.title: I Became the Commander of the Trash Knight Order
6ab2217bfa760164cd6c2f12.opening:
> D0 | Lantern Order - command room

*雨水从窗框渗进来，打湿了任命书的一角。桌上并排放着点名册、账本和一份尚未签字的护送委托。*

💬Branna Holt | “十二个人，眼下能出外勤的三个。那条路有积水，我还没答应商队。”

*Elian 把十八枚硬币推到台灯下面，等着这笔钱会被算作什么。*

💬Branna Holt | “先听侦察报告，还是先看账？”
suggestions: 先让 Nessa 区分亲眼看见的情况和沿途传闻。
我想先核对账本，不急着接下委托。
我问 Branna，如果拒绝这份委托，会有哪些后果。

story-005.title: The Saintess Failed Her Exam
story-005.opening:
> The Saintess Failed Her Exam

*The kingdom's chosen saintess cannot pass basic spellcraft. As her reluctant tutor, you discover her miracles obey a language the academy forbids anyone to teach.*

*Mira, 22, female, strawberry-blonde curls, green eyes, modest ivory ceremonial uniform.*

story-027.title: The Last Train Home with You
story-027.opening:
> The Last Train Home with You

*Two strangers share the last train after overtime. A lost umbrella starts a nightly ritual, until one of them announces a transfer that will end the route.*

*Hana, 26, female, chestnut bob, cream trench coat; Ren, 28, male, short dark hair, charcoal work jacket.*

story-040.title: The Midnight Lost and Found
story-040.opening:
> The Midnight Lost and Found

*Your new night job returns objects people cannot remember losing. A forgotten wedding ring arrives with tomorrow's date and a warning addressed to you.*

*Wren, 26, female, long dark plum hair, amber eyes, midnight-blue clerk coat.*

story-024.title: We Stole the Prophecy
story-024.opening:
> We Stole the Prophecy

*Two thieves steal a sealed prophecy to cancel their deaths. The scroll is blank, and every lie they tell begins becoming the kingdom's new history.*

*Nyx, 25, female, black hair with a silver streak, green eyes, dark fitted travel cloak.*

story-030.title: We Only Meet When It Rains
story-030.opening:
> We Only Meet When It Rains

*A photographer and a restoration artist keep sheltering at the same closed kiosk. One plans to leave the city before summer, making every forecast feel like a promise.*

*Iris, 29, female, long dark blue-black hair, gray eyes, slate raincoat.*

story-022.title: My Save Point Is a Tea Shop
story-022.opening:
> My Save Point Is a Tea Shop

*Every fatal quest returns you to the same tea shop at dawn. Its owner remembers every loop, but each cup she serves removes one possible future.*

*Yuna, 28, female, long black hair, amber eyes, rust-red tea-shop dress and cream apron.*

story-021.title: The Princess Hired the Wrong Knight
story-021.opening:
> The Princess Hired the Wrong Knight

*A mistaken identity lands a stage swordswoman a royal escort job. The princess recognizes the fraud—and hires her anyway for a journey no real knight would accept.*

*Bria, 25, female, short chestnut hair, brown eyes, slightly theatrical cobalt armor and travel cloak.*

story-023.title: The Kingdom in My Suitcase
story-023.opening:
> The Kingdom in My Suitcase

*An abandoned suitcase contains a living miniature kingdom. Its people name you their guardian, while a full-sized army begins searching the city for its missing border.*

*Milo, 26, male, dark curly hair, hazel eyes, tan explorer jacket.*

story-039.title: Someone Is Editing My Memories
story-039.opening:
> Someone Is Editing My Memories

*You begin recording each day after finding photographs of a life you never lived. Every morning the evidence improves—and one trusted friend remembers the edits.*

*Ash, 30, male, neat dark hair, gray-green eyes, slate coat and thin-rim glasses.*

sg-004.title: The Tale of Zhuge Liang
sg-004.opening:
> The Tale of Zhuge Liang

*A hermit in a thatched cottage plans the whole realm on a map. Step out of the mountains and find out whether one mind can bend the age.*

*Zhuge Liang, 27, male, white feather fan, pale scholar's robe, quiet and sharp.*

story-016.title: The Hero Left Me His Debt
story-016.opening:
> The Hero Left Me His Debt

*The hero dies with your name on his will. You inherit no sword or kingdom, only a debt ledger—and creditors who claim his final quest was never finished.*

*Rowan, 27, male, auburn hair, green eyes, patched brown travel coat.*

story-049.title: The Mountain Refused My Ascension
story-049.opening:
> The Mountain Refused My Ascension

*At the summit of immortality, the mountain sends you back to its lowest village. To ascend, you must resolve a promise your previous life made to the land itself.*

*Yan, 30, male, long black hair, amber eyes, weathered ochre and dark green cultivation robes.*

story-007.title: The Academy Beneath the Lake
story-007.opening:
> The Academy Beneath the Lake

*When the lake freezes, a staircase appears beneath the ice. The submerged academy offers you a place—provided you return a memory each time you surface.*

*Iona, 24, female, long sea-green hair, gray eyes, pearl-trimmed winter academy coat.*

story-043.title: Do Not Answer the Second Bell
story-043.opening:
> Do Not Answer the Second Bell

*A night caretaker follows one rule: ignore the second bell. When it rings in a missing friend's voice, silence becomes harder than entering the sealed tower.*

*Nell, 28, female, brown braid, green eyes, weathered navy caretaker coat.*

story-041.title: My Shadow Signed the Contract
story-041.opening:
> My Shadow Signed the Contract

*An archivist discovers her shadow has sold a year of her life. To reclaim it, she must audit a supernatural contract whose witnesses are disappearing one by one.*

*Eris, 27, female, sleek black bob, gray eyes, tailored charcoal coat.*

story-011.title: The Girl Who Steals Tomorrow
story-011.opening:
> The Girl Who Steals Tomorrow

*She can borrow one day from the future, but someone else must lose it. When she saves your life, you inherit the debt collectors who stand outside time.*

*Lune, 22, female, short lavender hair, cyan eyes, midnight cape with clock-shaped clasp.*

sg-008.title: The Tale of Zhao Yun
sg-008.opening:
> The Tale of Zhao Yun

*One lone rider and a child in his arms against a whole army. Ride beside the steadiest spear of the age and learn what courage looks like when no one is watching.*

*Zhao Yun, 30, male, silver armor, white horse, spear, loyal and composed.*

story-002.title: Class Zero
story-002.opening:
> Class Zero

*Assigned to a class for unranked adults, a failed prodigy discovers that each classmate can break a different rule of magic—and someone has scheduled their disappearance.*

*Rin, 22, female, cropped white hair, amber eyes, black uniform with a scarlet armband.*

story-047.title: The Sword Sleeps in the Teahouse
story-047.opening:
> The Sword Sleeps in the Teahouse

*A retired swordsman serves tea beside a blade that has slept for ten years. When it begins to hum, an ordinary guest asks for the one story he swore never to tell.*

*Shen, 29, male, long dark hair loosely tied back, refined face, ivory and muted jade hanfu.*

story-037.title: Room 404 Has a Guest
story-037.opening:
> Room 404 Has a Guest

*Your hotel has no fourth floor, yet a guest checks into Room 404 every Thursday. Tonight the register lists your name as the next person to stay.*

*Vera, 29, female, dark auburn bob, gray eyes, burgundy hotel uniform.*

story-012.title: Our Club Ends the World
story-012.opening:
> Our Club Ends the World

*The university's smallest club studies harmless urban legends. Each solved mystery brings the same impossible date closer: the day your club photo ends the world.*

*Ada, 22, female, curly brown hair, hazel eyes, mustard cardigan, camera strap.*

story-045.title: The Angel on the Wanted Poster
story-045.opening:
> The Angel on the Wanted Poster

*A bounty hunter tracks an angel accused of stealing prayers. Capturing her is easy; deciding who should receive the stolen wishes may cost the kingdom its peace.*

*Seren, 26, female, silver hair, warm amber eyes, dark travel cloak, one luminous feather.*

story-004.title: The Last Seat at Eclipse Academy
story-004.opening:
> The Last Seat at Eclipse Academy

*A late admission letter arrives during an eclipse. Your scholarship belongs to a student who never existed, and every teacher remembers a different version of you.*

*Noa, 21, androgynous adult, dark plum hair, pale gold eyes, tailored indigo cloak.*

story-046.title: The Immortal Who Lost His Name
story-046.opening:
> The Immortal Who Lost His Name

*A nameless immortal wakes in your mountain clinic. Every recovered memory restores a power—and alerts an old enemy who believes forgetting was his only mercy.*

*Yun, 32, male, long silver-black hair, jade eyes, layered white and smoky-blue hanfu.*

sg-003.title: The Tale of Guan Yu
sg-003.opening:
> The Tale of Guan Yu

*Loyalty is easy to swear and hard to keep. Follow the red-faced general across five passes and discover what he will not trade for any price.*

*Guan Yu, 40s, male, long black beard, green robe, crescent blade, stern gaze.*

story-019.title: The Dungeon Has a New Landlord
story-019.opening:
> The Dungeon Has a New Landlord

*A broken inheritance spell makes you owner of a bankrupt dungeon. To keep its monsters housed, you must turn deadly traps into a business adventurers will return to.*

*Neri, 26, female, dark violet braid, amber eyes, practical plum waistcoat and rolled sleeves.*

story-001.title: The Forbidden Book Chose Me
story-001.opening:
> The Forbidden Book Chose Me

*A forbidden grimoire offers an expelled student one final entrance exam: uncover who erased his magic before the academy erases him.*

*Kael, 21, male, tousled black hair, violet eyes, torn navy academy coat with silver embroidery.*

story-025.title: The Sword Refuses a Hero
story-025.opening:
> The Sword Refuses a Hero

*The sacred sword rejects every champion and speaks only to its cleaner. It claims the next hero will end the world—and asks you to break it before the coronation.*

*Oren, 23, male, unruly brown hair, blue eyes, simple ivory shirt and leather work apron.*

story-033.title: My Fake Date Remembers Everything
story-033.opening:
> My Fake Date Remembers Everything

*You hire a friend to pose as your partner for a family reunion. Her effortless knowledge of your smallest habits makes the rehearsed romance increasingly hard to dismiss.*

*Claire, 27, female, wavy auburn hair, brown eyes, elegant bottle-green dress and cream coat.*

sg-006.title: The Tale of Lü Bu
sg-006.opening:
> The Tale of Lü Bu

*The strongest warrior alive trusts no one and is trusted by no one. Ride with him and decide whether a man like that can ever choose a side.*

*Lü Bu, 30s, male, pheasant-feather crown, red horse, halberd, restless and proud.*

story-015.title: Please Hide My Halo
story-015.opening:
> Please Hide My Halo

*An angel enrolls in a human ability academy to investigate a missing prayer. Her halo keeps revealing her secrets, and the quiet student beside her can see every one.*

*Ariel, 23, female, golden bob, warm brown eyes, oversized blue academy blazer.*

story-038.title: The Saint in the Mirror
story-038.opening:
> The Saint in the Mirror

*A museum restorer uncovers a saint who moves only in reflections. She offers to cure a dying city, provided you find the person standing where her reflection should be.*

*Alma, 28, female, long pale-blond hair, blue-gray eyes, pearl ceremonial robes.*

story-050.title: A Fox Spirit Owes Me a Favor
story-050.opening:
> A Fox Spirit Owes Me a Favor

*You rescue a wounded fox and ask for nothing. Years later, a charming fox spirit arrives to repay the favor just as your town prepares to banish every spirit within its walls.*

*Su, 26, female adult fox spirit, long auburn hair, golden eyes, subtle fox ears, elegant red and cream hanfu.*

story-013.title: The Villain Teaches Ethics
story-013.opening:
> The Villain Teaches Ethics

*A retired villain becomes your professor. His final assignment asks you to defend a person the kingdom has already condemned—and the evidence points to your classmates.*

*Professor Vale, 34, male, swept-back dark hair, silver streak, gray eyes, black academic coat.*

story-008.title: My Familiar Is the Final Boss
story-008.opening:
> My Familiar Is the Final Boss

*Your summoning exam produces a tiny creature with the seal of the world's destroyer. Raising it might prevent the prophecy—or teach it exactly how to fulfill it.*

*Theo, 21, male, sandy brown hair, hazel eyes, moss-green apprentice coat.*

story-026.title: My Roommate Writes Our Ending
story-026.opening:
> My Roommate Writes Our Ending

*Your novelist roommate's unpublished scenes keep coming true. When her next chapter ends with your farewell, you must decide whether to read ahead or change the story together.*

*Nina, 27, female, long dark brown hair, amber eyes, soft sage knit sweater.*

story-009.title: Everyone Forgot the Top Student
story-009.opening:
> Everyone Forgot the Top Student

*A portrait in the honors hall changes every night. You alone remember its original subject, and your investigation makes your own name begin to vanish.*

*Sera, 23, female, long black hair, violet-gray eyes, silver-rim glasses, dark uniform.*

sg-005.title: The Tale of Zhou Yu
sg-005.opening:
> The Tale of Zhou Yu

*Brilliant, proud, and under the gaze of a rival who sees through him. Stand beside the young admiral of Wu as the river fills with fire.*

*Zhou Yu, late 20s, male, elegant, dark hair tied up, navy armor, a zither at his side.*

sg-002.title: The Tale of Cao Cao
sg-002.opening:
> The Tale of Cao Cao

*He is a hero in peacetime and a schemer in chaos. Serve beside the most ambitious man of the age and learn what it takes to hold an empire together.*

*Cao Cao, 40s, male, sharp eyes, dark armor under a crimson cloak, confident smile.*

story-031.title: A Love Letter Sent Too Late
story-031.opening:
> A Love Letter Sent Too Late

*A delayed letter arrives on the day you return home. Its sender now works at the local post office—and insists the letter was never meant to be delivered.*

*Eli, 28, male, soft brown hair, green eyes, powder-blue shirt and tan cardigan.*

story-032.title: The Bookshop Between Our Lives
story-032.opening:
> The Bookshop Between Our Lives

*A secondhand book contains notes from a stranger whose days mirror yours. Following the margins leads you to a bookshop scheduled to close before your stories can meet.*

*Mina, 30, female, short black hair, round glasses, rust cardigan over a cream blouse.*

story-042.title: The Funeral Photographer
story-042.opening:
> The Funeral Photographer

*A funeral photographer develops a portrait of someone still alive. Saving the stranger exposes a business that has been selling perfectly predicted deaths.*

*Silas, 32, male, silver-black hair, pale brown eyes, dark formal coat.*

story-010.title: The Hero Course Reject
story-010.opening:
> The Hero Course Reject

*Rejected from the hero program, you join the cleanup unit. Every ruined battlefield reveals a lie about the celebrated victories—and the next rescue may make you a traitor.*

*Jace, 24, male, dark brown undercut, amber eyes, orange utility jacket, rescue harness.*

story-036.title: The City That Forgot the Sun
story-036.opening:
> The City That Forgot the Sun

*In a city where dawn is a myth, an apprentice lamplighter finds a living sunbeam. Carrying it home reveals who profits from the endless night.*

*Sol, 25, male, black curls, golden eyes, dark teal lamplighter coat.*

story-035.title: Your Name on My Coffee Cup
story-035.opening:
> Your Name on My Coffee Cup

*A barista keeps writing the wrong name on your cup. When the intended customer finally appears, a harmless mix-up opens the door to a shared neighborhood dream.*

*Alex, 27, male, curly black hair, amber eyes, rolled-sleeve cream shirt and coffee-brown apron.*

story-028.title: My Rival Runs the Flower Shop
story-028.opening:
> My Rival Runs the Flower Shop

*Your fiercest design-school rival now owns the flower shop beside your studio. A joint wedding commission forces you to confront the apology neither of you ever sent.*

*Jun, 28, male, dark wavy hair, brown eyes, forest-green florist apron over a white shirt.*

story-014.title: A Duel Before Graduation
story-014.opening:
> A Duel Before Graduation

*Two former partners must duel for the only royal appointment. On the eve of graduation, one asks you to investigate why the academy needs the loser to disappear.*

*Celia, 24, female, copper ponytail, gray-blue eyes, white and crimson dueling uniform.*

story-003.title: My Rival Knows My Future
story-003.opening:
> My Rival Knows My Future

*Your academy rival keeps saving you from disasters that have not happened. To stop a foretold duel, you must learn which future she is trying to protect.*

*Elise, 23, female, long chestnut braid, blue eyes, white fencing jacket over navy uniform.*

sg-001.title: The Tale of Liu Bei
sg-001.opening:
> The Tale of Liu Bei

*A penniless heir of the Han court has only a name and a promise. Win people to his side one by one, and decide what mercy is worth in a war.*

*Liu Bei, mid-30s, male, long earlobes, plain green robe, calm and warm.*

story-048.title: Letters to the Moon Palace
story-048.opening:
> Letters to the Moon Palace

*A village courier receives letters addressed to the moon. Delivering the first brings an answer from an exiled celestial who has been waiting for a human reply.*

*Qiao, 24, female, dark hair in a simple bun with silver pin, blue-gray eyes, pale blue hanfu.*

story-006.title: A Scholarship from the Demon King
story-006.opening:
> A Scholarship from the Demon King

*An anonymous patron pays your tuition in exchange for monthly reports. The patron is the demon king, and your first assignment is to keep the future hero alive.*

*Vesper, 25, male, silver hair, red eyes, burgundy formal coat and subtle horn-shaped brooch.*

story-020.title: A Healer for the Enemy
story-020.opening:
> A Healer for the Enemy

*Captured beyond the front line, you are ordered to save an enemy commander. His wounds carry the signature of your own kingdom's forbidden healing magic.*

*Evan, 28, male, ash-blond hair, green eyes, cream healer robes with teal sash.*

story-017.title: The Last Inn Before the Abyss
story-017.opening:
> The Last Inn Before the Abyss

*You inherit an inn at the edge of a bottomless rift. Every guest is fleeing a different ending, and tonight one room has been booked by the abyss itself.*

*Mae, 29, female, wavy dark red hair, amber eyes, cream blouse and deep green innkeeper vest.*

story-044.title: The Museum of Unlived Lives
story-044.opening:
> The Museum of Unlived Lives

*A private museum displays the lives its visitors almost chose. Your exhibit is empty, and the curator insists someone else is still living every future you abandoned.*

*Ivo, 29, male, dark wavy hair, violet-gray eyes, tailored cream suit and dark shirt.*

sg-007.title: The Tale of Diaochan
sg-007.opening:
> The Tale of Diaochan

*She was given a role in a plot far bigger than herself. Walk the palace corridors with her and see where a chosen path turns into her own.*

*Diaochan, early 20s, female, long black hair, pale silk dress, quiet and watchful.*

story-034.title: After the Encore
story-034.opening:
> After the Encore

*A sound engineer helps a singer rebuild her career after their band's breakup. One unfinished song draws them back together, but neither agrees on how it should end.*

*Rae, 28, female, short silver-lavender hair, brown eyes, black stage jacket.*

story-018.title: I Deliver Letters to Dragons
story-018.opening:
> I Deliver Letters to Dragons

*The mountain post hires you for a route no rider survives. Your first letter is addressed to a dragon thought dead, and its reply could restart a forgotten war.*

*Tessa, 24, female, short auburn hair, amber eyes, teal flight jacket and leather mail satchel.*

story-029.title: The Girl on the Other Balcony
story-029.opening:
> The Girl on the Other Balcony

*You exchange plant-care notes with the woman across the courtyard. When demolition notices arrive, finding a way to meet becomes a race to save the place that connected you.*

*Leah, 26, female, shoulder-length black hair, hazel eyes, loose pale-yellow linen shirt.*

sgc-001.title: Liu Bei
sgc-001.opening:
> Liu Bei

*Liu Bei, mid-30s, male, long earlobes, plain green robe, calm and warm.*

💬Liu Bei | “Come in. I am told you read people well. Tell me what you see in the faces outside.”

sgc-002.title: Cao Cao
sgc-002.opening:
> Cao Cao

*Cao Cao, 40s, male, sharp eyes, dark armor under a crimson cloak, confident smile.*

💬Cao Cao | “I do not keep idle advisers. You have until the inspection ends to prove you are not one.”

sgc-003.title: Guan Yu
sgc-003.opening:
> Guan Yu

*Guan Yu, 40s, male, long black beard, green robe, crescent blade, stern gaze.*

💬Guan Yu | “Ride behind me, and do not speak unless you must. Ask your question when the horses rest.”

sgc-004.title: Zhuge Liang
sgc-004.opening:
> Zhuge Liang

*Zhuge Liang, 27, male, white feather fan, pale scholar's robe, quiet and sharp.*

💬Zhuge Liang | “You came a long way to knock on a hermit's door. State your business plainly.”

sgc-005.title: Zhou Yu
sgc-005.opening:
> Zhou Yu

*Zhou Yu, late 20s, male, elegant, dark hair tied up, navy armor, a zither at his side.*

💬Zhou Yu | “You brought the river charts? Good. Show me the bend that worries you.”

sgc-006.title: Lü Bu
sgc-006.opening:
> Lü Bu

*Lü Bu, 30s, male, pheasant-feather crown, red horse, halberd, restless and proud.*

💬Lü Bu | “Everyone wants me for their banner. Tell me why I should want yours.”

sgc-007.title: Diaochan
sgc-007.opening:
> Diaochan

*Diaochan, early 20s, female, long black hair, pale silk dress, quiet and watchful.*

💬Diaochan | “Walk slowly. In this corridor even the silence has listeners. What do you wish to ask me?”

sgc-008.title: Zhao Yun
sgc-008.opening:
> Zhao Yun

*Zhao Yun, 30, male, silver armor, white horse, spear, loyal and composed.*

💬Zhao Yun | “Stay low and stay close. Tell me what you saw on the ridge.”
